items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Trummy Young on trombone, Danny Barcelona on drums... That's when old Louis would play... I didn't never drink much, and Trummy drank a little.

ctx.x: Who was in the band when you joined?
Trummy Young on trombone, Danny Barcelona on drums, Irv...the bass player...
I can't think of his name. I know who you mean.

items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: That's how I happened to play with him sometimes... He had a real good trumpet player... trombone player named Tram

ctx.x: ...trombone player named Tram... He had different trumpet players. He had a real good trumpet player from New Orleans named Dimes.
